reference_project.name: Pearl Harbor National Memorial Theater chilled-water pump replacement

requirements.scope_note: The published single-pump schedule supplies the per-pump technical basis. Pactline's package quantity and procurement events are sandbox fixtures.

duty_point.speed_basis: The scheduled 1,800 RPM is the nominal speed class for the demo. Each manufacturer's curve retains its plotted speed.

criteria.evidence_needed: Manufacturer submittal identifying the pump type of the offered model.

criteria.basis: The demo treats the scheduled head as a minimum. No downward acceptance tolerance is applied.
criteria.evidence_needed: A head-flow curve that brackets the duty flow on the offered impeller, speed, and fluid basis.

criteria.basis: The demo treats the scheduled efficiency as a pump efficiency minimum. No downward acceptance tolerance is applied.
criteria.evidence_needed: Pump efficiency at the duty flow for the offered trim and speed, using the efficiency definition on the source curve.
Rated horsepower on the offered motor's nameplate or selected motor data sheet.
Documented compatibility of the offered motor with the project's line voltage.
Phase count on the offered motor's nameplate or selected motor data sheet.

criteria.basis: M1 lists voltage and phase. The demo uses the U.S. 60 Hz electrical basis.
criteria.evidence_needed: Documented 60 Hz compatibility for the offered motor.
Package or installation submittal identifying the elastomeric insulation and its thickness.
Package or installation submittal identifying the insulation jacketing material.

open_criteria.evidence_needed: Site NPSH available at duty, the specified margin, and the configuration's NPSH required curve.
Verified site envelope, mounting and clearance limits, pipe tie-in details, and the selected package drawing.
Site fluid and treatment chemistry, required materials, and the selected casing, impeller, and seal construction.
Site maximum pressure and temperature, and pressure and temperature ratings for the selected flange, casing, and seal.

product_configurations.curve_fluid_basis: Clean-water pump literature. Test temperature and specific gravity are unspecified on the plot.

curve.method: Scaled the published US GPM and feet axes and read the 9.5-inch head curve, pump efficiency contours, and NPSHr on its separate right-hand scale.

product_configurations.curve_fluid_basis: Clear water as specified on curve PC-4005 Rev A.

curve.method: Scaled the published US GPM and feet axes and read the 6.25-inch head curve, pump efficiency contours, and NPSHr at the same horizontal coordinates on the upper plot.

catalog_connection.basis: Use the connection sizes from the model-specific dimension drawing. The earlier curve-book header uses a different size designation.
